import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def custom_kernel(
    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr,
    N, Cin, Din, Hin, Win, Cout,
    stride_d, stride_h, stride_w,
    pad_d, pad_h, pad_w,
    dil_d, dil_h, dil_w,
    groups,
    Dout, Hout, Wout,
    x_sN, x_sC, x_sD, x_sH, x_sW,
    w_sOC, w_sCIG, w_sKD, w_sKH, w_sKW,
    y_sN, y_sC, y_sD, y_sH, y_sW,
      BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_OC: tl.constexpr,
      KD: tl.constexpr, KH: tl.constexpr, KW: tl.constexpr,
      CIG: tl.constexpr,  # Cin // groups
      HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
      GROUPS_EQ1: tl.constexpr,
      BLOCK_KW: tl.constexpr
  ):
    pid_m = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_co = tl.program_id(1)

    tl.static_assert(BLOCK_KW >= KW)
    # Offsets in flattened output space and output-channel tiles
    m_offsets = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
    oc_offsets = pid_co * BLOCK_OC + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_OC)

    M = N * Dout * Hout * Wout
    m_mask = m_offsets < M
    oc_mask = oc_offsets < Cout

    # Cast to int64 for address calculations
    m = m_offsets.to(tl.int64)
    oc = oc_offsets.to(tl.int64)

    Wout_i64 = tl.full([1], Wout, tl.int64)
    Hout_i64 = tl.full([1], Hout, tl.int64)
    Dout_i64 = tl.full([1], Dout, tl.int64)

    # Decode (n, d, h, w) from flattened m
    w_idx = m % Wout_i64
    tmp = m // Wout_i64
    h_idx = tmp % Hout_i64
    tmp = tmp // Hout_i64
    d_idx = tmp % Dout_i64
    n_idx = tmp // Dout_i64

    # Convolution base indices
    stride_d_i64 = tl.full([1], stride_d, tl.int64)
    stride_h_i64 = tl.full([1], stride_h, tl.int64)
    stride_w_i64 = tl.full([1], stride_w, tl.int64)
    pad_d_i64 = tl.full([1], pad_d, tl.int64)
    pad_h_i64 = tl.full([1], pad_h, tl.int64)
    pad_w_i64 = tl.full([1], pad_w, tl.int64)
    dil_d_i64 = tl.full([1], dil_d, tl.int64)
    dil_h_i64 = tl.full([1], dil_h, tl.int64)
    dil_w_i64 = tl.full([1], dil_w, tl.int64)

    d_base = d_idx * stride_d_i64 - pad_d_i64
    h_base = h_idx * stride_h_i64 - pad_h_i64
    w_base = w_idx * stride_w_i64 - pad_w_i64

    # Strides as int64
    x_sN = tl.full([1], x_sN, tl.int64)
    x_sC = tl.full([1], x_sC, tl.int64)
    x_sD = tl.full([1], x_sD, tl.int64)
    x_sH = tl.full([1], x_sH, tl.int64)
    x_sW = tl.full([1], x_sW, tl.int64)
    y_sN = tl.full([1], y_sN, tl.int64)
    y_sC = tl.full([1], y_sC, tl.int64)
    y_sD = tl.full([1], y_sD, tl.int64)
    y_sH = tl.full([1], y_sH, tl.int64)
    y_sW = tl.full([1], y_sW, tl.int64)
    w_sOC = tl.full([1], w_sOC, tl.int64)
    w_sCIG = tl.full([1], w_sCIG, tl.int64)
    w_sKD = tl.full([1], w_sKD, tl.int64)
    w_sKH = tl.full([1], w_sKH, tl.int64)
    w_sKW = tl.full([1], w_sKW, tl.int64)

    Din_i64 = tl.full([1], Din, tl.int64)
    Hin_i64 = tl.full([1], Hin, tl.int64)
    Win_i64 = tl.full([1], Win, tl.int64)
    Cout_i64 = tl.full([1], Cout, tl.int64)
    groups_i64 = tl.full([1], groups, tl.int64)
    oc_per_group = Cout_i64 // groups_i64

    # Group id per oc
    group_id = oc // oc_per_group  # [BLOCK_OC]
    cig_i64 = tl.full([1], CIG, tl.int64)

    # Accumulator
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_M), dtype=tl.float32)

    # Precompute base for (n, d, h, w) contribution into input pointer for each m-lane
    base_n = n_idx * x_sN
    # din/hin/win depend on kd/kh/kw; build within loops

    # Loop over kernel and input channels within group
    for kd in tl.static_range(0, KD):
        din = d_base + tl.full([1], kd, tl.int64) * dil_d_i64
        in_d_ok = (din >= 0) & (din < Din_i64)
        for kh in tl.static_range(0, KH):
            hin = h_base + tl.full([1], kh, tl.int64) * dil_h_i64
            in_h_ok = (hin >= 0) & (hin < Hin_i64)
            if GROUPS_EQ1:
                # Vectorize across KW for groups==1: load a [KW, BLOCK_M] tile of inputs once and reuse across OC lanes
                kw_idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_KW)
                kw_idx_i64 = kw_idx.to(tl.int64)
                mask_k_row = (kw_idx[None, :] < KW)
                mask_k_col = (kw_idx[:, None] < KW)
                win_mat = w_base[None, :] + kw_idx_i64[:, None] * dil_w_i64
                in_w_ok_mat = (win_mat >= 0) & (win_mat < Win_i64)
                mask_spatial_mat = (m_mask[None, :]) & (in_d_ok[None, :]) & (in_h_ok[None, :]) & in_w_ok_mat
                mask_spatial_mat = mask_spatial_mat & mask_k_col
                base_nhw0 = base_n + din * x_sD + hin * x_sH + w_base * x_sW
                for ci in tl.static_range(0, CIG):
                    ci_local = tl.full([1], ci, tl.int64)
                    # Weights tile over BLOCK_KW
                    ptr_w_tile = w_ptr + (oc[:, None] * w_sOC) + (ci_local * w_sCIG) + (tl.full([1], kd, tl.int64) * w_sKD) + (tl.full([1], kh, tl.int64) * w_sKH) + (kw_idx[None, :].to(tl.int64) * w_sKW)
                    mask_w = (oc_mask[:, None]) & mask_k_row
                    w_tile = tl.load(ptr_w_tile, mask=mask_w, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                    # Inputs tile over BLOCK_KW x M (broadcast across OC)
                    ptr_x_tile = x_ptr + (ci_local * x_sC) + base_nhw0[None, :] + (kw_idx_i64[:, None] * dil_w_i64 * x_sW)
                    x_tile = tl.load(ptr_x_tile, mask=mask_spatial_mat, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                    # Reduce across KW without scalar indexing
                    w3 = tl.reshape(w_tile, (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_KW, 1))
                    x3 = tl.reshape(x_tile, (1, BLOCK_KW, BLOCK_M))
                    acc += tl.sum(w3 * x3, axis=1)
            else:
                # Vectorize across KW for general grouped case as well
                kw_idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_KW)
                kw_idx_i64 = kw_idx.to(tl.int64)
                mask_k_row = (kw_idx[None, :] < KW)
                mask_k_col = (kw_idx[:, None] < KW)
                win_mat = w_base[None, :] + kw_idx_i64[:, None] * dil_w_i64
                in_w_ok_mat = (win_mat >= 0) & (win_mat < Win_i64)
                mask_spatial_mat = (m_mask[None, :]) & (in_d_ok[None, :]) & (in_h_ok[None, :]) & in_w_ok_mat
                mask_spatial_mat = mask_spatial_mat & mask_k_col
                base_nhw0 = base_n + din * x_sD + hin * x_sH + w_base * x_sW
                for ci in tl.static_range(0, CIG):
                    ci_local = tl.full([1], ci, tl.int64)
                    # Weights tile over BLOCK_KW
                    ptr_w_tile = w_ptr + (oc[:, None] * w_sOC) + (ci_local * w_sCIG) + (tl.full([1], kd, tl.int64) * w_sKD) + (tl.full([1], kh, tl.int64) * w_sKH) + (kw_idx[None, :].to(tl.int64) * w_sKW)
                    mask_w = (oc_mask[:, None]) & mask_k_row
                    w_tile = tl.load(ptr_w_tile, mask=mask_w, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                    # General grouped case: per-oc lane input channel
                    ci_global = group_id * cig_i64 + ci_local  # [BLOCK_OC]
                    # Inputs tile over [OC, KW, M]
                    ptr_x_tile = x_ptr + (ci_global[:, None, None] * x_sC) + base_nhw0[None, None, :] + (kw_idx_i64[None, :, None] * dil_w_i64 * x_sW)
                    mask_x = (oc_mask[:, None, None]) & (mask_spatial_mat[None, :, :])
                    x_tile = tl.load(ptr_x_tile, mask=mask_x, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
                    # Reduce across KW
                    acc += tl.sum(w_tile[:, :, None] * x_tile, axis=1)

    if HAS_BIAS:
        b = tl.load(b_ptr + oc, mask=oc_mask, other=0.0)
        acc += b.to(tl.float32)[:, None]

    # Store
    ptr_y = y_ptr + (n_idx[None, :] * y_sN) + (oc[:, None] * y_sC) + (d_idx[None, :] * y_sD) + (h_idx[None, :] * y_sH) + (w_idx[None, :] * y_sW)
    mask_y = (oc_mask[:, None]) & (m_mask[None, :])
    tl.store(ptr_y, acc, mask=mask_y)
